summary: preview_renderer is a clean pure-function module with clear docstrings, frozenset constants, recursive node walker, and all three hardening layers per tech-spec Decision 1. Stdlib-only (html, re), no side effects, no requirements.txt change. Attribute rendering was strengthened during self-review by dropping malformed attribute names.

findings.description: _ALLOWED_TAGS is a frozenset; task spec suggested a plain set. Functionally equivalent; frozenset is arguably safer.
render_html escapes title with quote=True even though <title> and <h1> are text contexts where attribute-quote escaping is not strictly required.
findings.recommendation: Harmless; quote=True is correct when the same safe_title is later reused in attributes or when defensive uniformity is preferred.
